title: Use the same 4-person character sheet and the same 15-second prompt across…
content:
Use the same 4-person character sheet and the same 15-second prompt across models (e.g., Seedance2.5 vs MiniMaxH3) to run a controlled comparison of output quality and consistency.
Pack your 15-second prompt with explicit requirements: maintain all 4 characters consistently, transition group → solo → group, vary facial expressions and poses, and generate music with MV-style edits synced to the music.
